title: Need
description: What a caller sends search: a need, not a sentence (david-learns/decisions/2026-10-25-the-question-bank-is-searched-for-question-sets-by-agents-sendin). Plain words are one field among several.

words.description: The need in plain words, in the caller's language

words_en.description: English terms for the keyword arm when the need is not in English; never stored on a page

resemble.description: A task to resemble, e.g. a homework problem's text

language.description: The caller's language. Khan text is Polish and English only; a Ukrainian-speaking parent may still ask in Ukrainian.

grade.description: Canonical form: the bare number, e.g. "3"
